content_units: September 18 Film Club Lineup
A balanced 3-film mini lineup that stays   under 7 hours  , varies the tone, and includes   multiple pre-2011 releases  . Total runtime:   6h 21m  .
Viewing Order and Discussion Prompts
Order   Film   Year   Runtime   Tone in the lineup   Why it fits   Discussion prompt

1     The Social Network     2010   2h 0m   Fast, sharp, cerebral   Opens the night with energy and moral ambiguity grounded in ambition, betrayal, and status.     Is Mark driven more by insecurity, genius, or resentment—and does the film want us to admire him anyway?

2     Black Swan     2010   1h 48m   Psychological, intense, claustrophobic   Shifts the club into a more intimate and unstable portrait of obsession and self-destruction.     At what point does Nina stop being a victim of pressure and become complicit in her own unraveling?

3     There Will Be Blood     2007   2h 33m   Epic, dark, operatic   Ends with the biggest moral crater of the night: greed, domination, and isolation on a grand scale.     Is Daniel Plainview evil from the start, or does capitalism simply reward the worst parts of him?
Why This Trio Works
-   Runtime fit:   120 + 108 + 153 =   381 minutes   =   6h 21m
-   Variety in tone:   one witty and talk-driven drama, one psychological descent, one sweeping character study
-   Theme fit:   all three center on protagonists who are compelling, impressive, and ethically troubling
-   Pre-2011 requirement:   all three are released   before 2011
Host Notes for Flow
-   Best order for stamina:   start with the most accessible, put the most nerve-fraying film in the middle, and finish with the heavyweight closer.
- Plan for   2 short breaks   of 10–15 minutes each if you want discussion between films.

- If you want the room to end on a more socially explosive note instead of an epic character study, swap   There Will Be Blood   for   Parasite  —but this current order is stronger for the “morally complicated protagonist” theme.
